subject.title: fix: make bridge rpc text sends idempotent

question: Should this message-delivery fix wait for SIP-disabled live bridge proof before merge, or may maintainers accept source and unit-test confidence only?
rationale: The source repair is plausible, but the reported failure occurs in private Messages/IMCore physical delivery that this checkout cannot exercise and the PR body still marks as unproven.

options.title: Wait for reproducer proof
options.body: Require the reproducing Mac to attach redacted request, response, outbound-row, unique-GUID, response-mapping, duplicate/missing-text, and recipient-confirmation results before merge.

options.title: Accept source-only risk
options.body: Merge based on the atomic-claim implementation and tests, with maintainers owning any remaining duplicate-send or missing-send behavior found only in live IMCore.

options.title: Pause until a Mac is available
options.body: Leave the PR open but blocked if the reproducing SIP-disabled environment cannot be scheduled soon.

recommendation.title: Wait for reproducer proof
recommendation.body: Require the reproducing Mac to attach redacted request, response, outbound-row, unique-GUID, response-mapping, duplicate/missing-text, and recipient-confirmation results before merge.

likelyOwner.reason: steipete owns the current fix branch, has current-main history in the watcher, and already asked for the exact live validation gate.
